title: Geologic map of the Orangeburg North quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Lennon, Gered, Doar, W.R., III, and Clendenin, C.W., 2014, Geologic map of the Orangeburg North quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-213, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Symbols: dg and PEwh legible inline; QHfw, PEodb and PEc inferred from placement (flagged). 'NPdu' is printed after the Duplin estuarine description and the correlation chart shows 'NPdu | NPs', so the Duplin symbols could not be assigned and are omitted. Thicknesses with '|' as first digit (freshwater marsh, Carolina bay, Duplin Formation '| to 56', Duplin estuarine '| to 25', Duplin sands '| to 50') not recorded. The explanation lists a fault symbol, but no fault can be read on the map face. Bodies of water skipped.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section on this sheet; SCGS drill hole number 38-374 shown in the explanation, logs on file at SCGS and not printed. Duplin Formation inland limit at +220 ft (+67.5 m) in the map area (page 1). Correlation chart (page 1) lists Paleocene and Upper Cretaceous units below the Eocene units with unconformities, but their descriptions are not on the sheet (OCR 'PEG:'). Vertical datum not stated; base map uses 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 1.5 meters.
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Symbols: dg and PEwh legible inline; QHfw, PEodb and PEc inferred from placement (flagged). 'NPdu' is printed after the Duplin estuarine description and the correlation chart shows 'NPdu | NPs', so the Duplin symbols could not be assigned and are omitted. Thicknesses with '|' as first digit (freshwater marsh, Carolina bay, Duplin Formation '| to 56', Duplin estuarine '| to 25', Duplin sands '| to 50') not recorded. The explanation lists a fault symbol, but no fault trace or location can be read on the map face; the fault entry is kept as inferred and sent to review (legend symbol only). Bodies of water skipped.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise in the OCR). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (NPdu is the Duplin estuarine unit, NPds the Duplin sands; the Duplin Formation heading has no box). Five thicknesses printed with '|' for the first digit are now recorded as 1 (inferred). Duplin inland limit +220 ft recorded as a stated top (no vertical datum printed). The fault entry is kept from the explanation; the page image shows dashed fault traces on the map face but no name, location text or attitude. Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (38-xxx, 09-xxx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Correlation chart lists Paleocene and Upper Cretaceous units with no descriptions on the sheet. Bodies of water not recorded.
